# Disable Built-In Game Mode Respawning

Source: [wiki article 4366](../archive/4366.md); edited 2024-11-26.

Exact pinned API: [Disable Built-In Game Mode Respawning](../../api/actions/disable-built-in-game-mode-respawning.md).

<a id="wiki-4366-n1"></a>

- Disabling built-in respawning prevents automatic respawns for selected players but allows scripting commands to respawn them.
